verdicts.reason: A: the 'Build Your Mix' CTA is shrunk to a tiny pill and the ingredient pills next to it are bigger (ROSEMARY and WILD HONEY dwarf it), so the CTA loses its priority. The pills are also sized inconsistently and the row runs right up to the edge. The SOLSTICE logo is a speck stuck off-centre at the top, and the legal line has been promoted to subhead size. B: the logo and headline sit on a cleaner centred axis, the pills match each other and the spacing is calmer. But the CTA and the pill labels are near-illegibly small, the legal line is still oversized as a subhead, and the can crowds the bottom edge. B is still the less broken of the two.
